upstream_thy_002.reuse_rule: Reuse the exact THY-002 forecast without changing its information set, half-life, prior, module map, or projected-timeline claim boundary.

source.frame_rule: Use every Multi-SWE repository with at least one complete nested H10 Origin under the fixed 20-history plus non-overlapping 10-future schedule.
source.timestamp_policy: Use the already-declared GitHub pull-request createdAt projection. This is source-time-safe counterfactual development, not native Task arrival.
source.label_policy: Use retrospective reference-fix patch modules for task-space scoring and Selection construction; do not call them arrival-native attributes.

module_projection.path_rule: first two parent-directory components; use the available prefix when shorter
module_projection.path_input_rule: Git --name-only paths are already repository-relative and retain real top-level a/ or b/ directories; reference-patch diff headers remove exactly one side prefix before applying path_rule
module_projection.git_path_transport: read git show --name-only with NUL delimiters so whitespace, non-ASCII names, and Git quotePath behavior cannot alter module identity
module_projection.task_label_rule: unique eligible paths in the source reference fix patch, split uniformly; no eligible path maps to OTHER
module_projection.origin_vocabulary: ROOT, OTHER, cutoff-safe historical Task modules, and reachable eligible Git modules
module_projection.future_unseen_rule: a future patch module absent from the Origin vocabulary maps to OTHER

rolling_origin.remainder_policy: leading remainder is absorbed into the initial history so every retained future cohort is a complete non-overlapping H10 block
rolling_origin.block_policy: H5 is the first five Tasks in the same H10 block
rolling_origin.ordering: projected pull-request createdAt then source Task identity
rolling_origin.task_time_projection: use the frozen Multi-SWE GitHub pull-request createdAt sidecar as a source-time-safe counterfactual clock
rolling_origin.origin_snapshot: latest first-parent commit on the frozen default-branch history whose committer time is at or before the Origin cutoff
rolling_origin.future_dated_ancestor_policy: clamp structurally reachable negative clock age to zero and report the count

forecast.name: Generator-Calibrated Module Exposure
forecast.historical_task_mass: one unit per admitted historical Task split uniformly across retrospective eligible reference-fix patch modules
forecast.historical_exposure: one unit per reachable non-root non-merge commit split uniformly across eligible touched modules, from the repository's first selected source Task time through the Origin cutoff
forecast.recent_exposure: the identical commit-touch exposure with a fixed exponential age kernel
forecast.no_recent_exposure_rule: G_m=0 contributes exactly zero forecast mass
forecast.zero_total_rule: zero historical or recent eligible exposure is an admission failure

selector.name: Brier Projection Coreset
selector.objective: minimize squared Euclidean distance between selected Task module-distribution and the unchanged THY-002 forecast
selector.construction: greedily add one unselected historical Task minimizing squared distance to budget times forecast, then apply strict-improvement deterministic one-swap polishing to a local optimum
selector.tie_rule: domain-separated SHA-256 of repository and Task identity; swap ties use the canonical selected-identity digest; no time or outcome tie-break
selector.cold_support_rule: retain forecast mass on modules with no historical Task support, report its mass, count, and irreducible Brier lower bound; do not renormalize, synthesize pseudo-Tasks, or use fallback modules
selector.cold_support_failure: reject an Origin only when all forecast mass lacks historical Task support
selector.membership_freeze: Stage A binds exact candidate, stationary-control, and recency-control Task identities before any Agent outcome join.

task_space_estimand.metric: multiclass Brier loss on equal-Task, fractional multi-module distributions
task_space_estimand.contrast_sign: candidate minus control; negative favors the candidate
task_space_estimand.aggregation: average Origins within each repository, then macro-average repositories equally
mechanism_ablations: recent Git exposure without Generator-yield calibration
mapping_controls: stationary Brier coreset targeting full historical Task distribution
task_space_estimand.uncertainty: deterministic 20000-draw repository bootstrap; one predeclared primary inferential contrast at H5

random_landscape.role: dense equal-budget sampling calibration, never a replacement for full history
random_landscape.sampling: independent uniform ten-Task subset without replacement for every Origin; one draw index is aggregated repository-first across the whole cohort
random_landscape.reuse: the same task-space draw memberships and indices are reused for H5 and H10; any later outcome amendment must reuse the same indices across all Agent configurations
random_landscape.position: midrank fraction of random macro-repository contrasts strictly worse than the candidate plus half of ties

task_space_gate.h5_forecast: forecast-minus-full below zero, repository-bootstrap upper bound below zero, at least 7/11 repositories favorable, and forecast beats both Git-only and yield-only
task_space_gate.h10_forecast: forecast-minus-full below zero, at least 6/11 repositories favorable, and forecast beats both Git-only and yield-only
task_space_gate.h5_mapping: selection-minus-full below zero with repository-bootstrap upper bound below zero, at least 7/11 repositories favorable, every leave-one-repository-out contrast below zero, candidate beats stationary coreset, and random midrank at least 0.90
task_space_gate.h10_mapping: selection-minus-full below zero, at least 6/11 repositories favorable, candidate beats stationary coreset, and random midrank at least 0.50
task_space_gate.decision: all gates pass or retire this deterministic mapping without opening Agent outcomes

downstream_outcome_contract.amendment_rule: After a Stage A pass only, one focused executor amendment may bind the exact Stage A result and membership digests plus the already-open outcome bytes. It may not change source, Origins, forecast, memberships, budget, metric, controls, random indices, gates, or aggregation.
downstream_outcome_contract.per_agent_loss: absolute difference between selected-history pass rate and future-cohort pass rate
downstream_outcome_contract.cell_loss: For every Agent configuration a and Origin o, compute the absolute selected-history pass-rate minus future-cohort pass-rate error for candidate and each control; define d[a,o] as candidate error minus control error.
downstream_outcome_contract.primary_aggregation: For each repository and Agent configuration, average d[a,o] equally over that repository's Origins. Average those values equally over all 36 configurations within the repository, then macro-average the 11 repository values equally.
downstream_outcome_contract.agent_configuration_view: For each configuration, average its Origin contrasts within repository and then macro-average the same 11 repositories. A configuration is favorable exactly when this macro contrast is below zero.
downstream_outcome_contract.configuration_axis_rule: Every exact configuration ID in the imported contract has form YYYYMMDD_<harness>_<model>. Harness is exactly one of MSWE-agent, MagentLess, or MopenHands; model is the complete remaining suffix. The date is provenance, not a grouping axis. This yields 12 model groups with one configuration per harness.
downstream_outcome_contract.model_harness_views: For each model or harness, average its member configurations' repository-level contrasts equally, then macro-average the same 11 repositories. A group is favorable exactly when this contrast is below zero. Provider groups are descriptive only.
downstream_outcome_contract.repository_bootstrap: Resample the 11 repositories with replacement and keep every sampled repository's complete Origin and 36-configuration cluster intact. Recompute the full primary aggregation in each draw.
downstream_outcome_contract.configuration_missingness: All 36 configurations must have complete binary outcomes for every one of the 1337 frozen Tasks; no imputation, failed-as-zero rule, configuration dropping, or task dropping is allowed.
downstream_outcome_contract.random_calibration: For random draw j, reuse its frozen per-Origin subset for every Agent configuration and both horizons, compute d[j,a,o], and apply the identical Origin-to-repository, configuration-within-repository, and repository-macro aggregation. Candidate position uses midrank against the resulting 20000 primary macro contrasts.
downstream_outcome_contract.source_replication_scope: This contract contains one Multi-SWE development source only. SWE-bench Verified and any later or prospective source require a separate freeze and are not implied by a Multi-SWE pass.
downstream_outcome_contract.decision_boundary: A pass nominates THY-002S for independent confirmation only. These outcomes were already open and cannot confirm a Selector, authorize sealed holdout access, or create a Runner default.

forbidden_changes_after_freeze: forecast formula, half-life, prior, or module map
source repositories, task identities, projected times, Origins, or horizons
Selection budget, objective, greedy rule, swap rule, ties, or cold-support behavior
full-history baseline, stationary control, random sampler, aggregation, or gates
opening Agent outcomes before a Stage A pass
opening the six SWE-bench Verified holdout Agents
claiming projected timestamps or retrospective patch modules are native prospective evidence
claim_boundary: Stage A tests whether the retained THY-002 module forecast can be converted into one deterministic local budget-ten Selection that is structurally closer to future Task mix than full history and random subsets. It cannot establish Agent-response prediction, benchmark validity, native prospective validity, or a production Selector.
